To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

students who used emotion focused coping strategies performed poorly in the internship, whereas students who used problem focused coping strategies and information focused coping strategies performed well in the internship.

the coping strategies of students in hospitality internships can be classified as problem focused, emotion focused, and information focused, and that longitudinal and performance differences exist among these three coping strategies.
the coping strategies of hospitality interns are affected by their performance and the duration of their internships.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the longitudinal and performance effects of student coping in hospitality intern.
the use of different coping strategies by hospitality interns and the longitudinal and performance differences of the coping strategies.
the longitudinal changes in the use of coping strategies, and the relationship between coping strategies and internship performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
hospitality internships should be a win-win situation for both students and managers.
the hospitality industry should be concerned with students’ well-being and performance during internships.
the hotel managers should provide a positive atmosphere and positive reinforcement for the students, and the schools should provide training and meetings before internships.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
hospitality internships are an excellent opportunity for students to learn how to cope with the work environment and for hotels to recruit high performing employees.

hospitality internships can be an important learning experience for students and a valuable source of labor for the hotel industry, but both students and managers should pay more attention to the importance of information focused strategy.
hospitality managers should be more aware of the importance of coping in hospitality intern.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of mixed methods can be a valuable approach for hospitality researchers and practitioners to explore the coping strategies of students during internships.
the longitudinal and dyad perspectives are important for understanding student coping in hospitality internhips.

the use of coping strategies in hospitality internships is a complex process, and the findings from the present study can help managers to better understand the use of coping and to develop strategies to improve the quality of internships.
